create_bulk_from_atoms: create a Bulk object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a bulk crystal structure
create_bulk_from_db_index: create a Bulk object by selecting from the bulk database using a specific index ID
create_bulk_from_src_id: create a Bulk object by selecting from the bulk database using a source ID like mp-30
get_slabs_from_bulk: get all possible slab surfaces from a Bulk object with a maximum Miller index value
sample_random_bulk: sample a random Bulk structure from the bulk database when no selection criteria are provided
